mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.08% is below 0.5% threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.08% is below 4.5% threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and inflation remains elevated (CPIAUCSL > 280), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.08% and CPIAUCSL at 282.543
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 280 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the tight labor market supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment above 4.5% (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating economic conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current UNRATE at 4.0% is below 4.5% threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1700 thousand units (HOUST > 1700), it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current HOUST at 1722.0 is above 1700 threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1700 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 280), elevated price pressures erode real corporate profits and increase uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current CPIAUCSL at 282.543 is above 280 threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 280 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises and GDP growth (GDPC1) accelerates, it signals robust economic activity and strong corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current INDPRO at 100.5726 and GDPC1 at 21988.737
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises and GDPC1 growth accelerates (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).
